# Nishanth Ravula

> Software and ML engineer who builds anomaly detection and data systems for retail operations, and a PhD student in Artificial Intelligence researching self-supervised time-series anomaly detection and responsible AI. Open to ML and software engineering roles. Based in Texas, open to relocation.

Contact: nishanth.ravula@outlook.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/ravula-nishanth-0716/ · https://github.com/Nishanthravula

## Experience

- Software Developer, Dollar General (April 2024 to present): anomaly detection for retail ordering data across the store network; Oracle performance tuning and reconciliation; a DuckDB and FastAPI analytical layer prototype; JSON-schema validation for MongoDB inputs that reduced user-side data errors by 40%; CI/CD.
- Assistant System Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services (July 2021 to July 2022): deep learning for autonomous-vehicle perception in TensorFlow; improved model accuracy by 20%; led data annotation quality control; Azure ML deployment.
- Web Developer, Halfway (February 2020 to June 2021): React and Next.js front end; 35% faster pages.
- Frontend Developer Intern, PrimeFort (October 2019 to January 2020): React interfaces.

## Selected work

- [RSTAD](https://nishanthravula.netlify.app/#research): self-supervised anomaly detector for retail time series (Transformer masked autoencoder, dual-branch scoring with a kNN memory bank). Paper in preparation.
- [Responsible AI audits](https://github.com/Nishanthravula/responsible-ai-audits): six published audits of AI systems against the EU AI Act, GDPR and NIST AI RMF.
- [mcp-guardrail](https://nishanthravula.netlify.app/#work): open-source stdio proxy that redacts secrets and personal data from Model Context Protocol tool results.
- [Snapshot analytical layer](https://nishanthravula.netlify.app/#work): DuckDB snapshots over partitioned Parquet served through FastAPI.
